name: creator-center
description: A local-first desktop workspace for a physics creator: accounts, analytics, plans, timeline and community.

scripts.dev: cross-env CREATOR_CENTER_DATA_DIR=.data/dev concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "tsx watch apps/server/src/index.ts" "npm run dev -w @creator-center/web"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @creator-center/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @creator-center/shared && npm run build -w @creator-center/server && npm run build -w @creator-center/web && npm run build -w @creator-center/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @creator-center/shared && npm run typecheck -w @creator-center/shared && npm run build -w @creator-center/server && npm run typecheck -w @creator-center/server && npm run typecheck -w @creator-center/web && npm run typecheck -w @creator-center/desktop
scripts.dev:demo: cross-env CREATOR_CENTER_DATA_DIR=.data/demo concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "tsx watch apps/server/src/index.ts" "npm run dev -w @creator-center/web"
